snippet.title: Coloratura - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019531

Experience the world through sound in "Coloratura", coming soon to PlayStation 5. 

Step into the role of Alex, a young musician who has lost her sight, and navigate a fully explorable 3D world using immersive spatial audio. Solve musical puzzles, uncover an emotional story, and discover a groundbreaking adventure designed to be experienced through hearing, where imagination becomes your greatest guide.

#ps5 #ps5games
